answer_1.quote: We develop new tools to build disentangled textual representations and evaluate them on fair classification and two sentence generation tasks, namely, style transfer and conditional sentence generation.
answer_1.outputs: Generated sentences with transferred style or conditioned on attributes

answer_2.quote: We measure the style of the output sentence by using a fastText classifier. For content preservation, we follow ... and compute both: (i) the cosine measure between source and generated sentence embeddings ... and (ii) the BLEU score ... We evaluate the fluency of the language with the perplexity given by a GPT-2 pretrained model ... we report the log-perplexity.

answer_4.quote: Human evaluation results are presented in Tab. 1. Tab. 1 gathers results of human evaluation and show that our surrogates can better disentangle style while preserving more content than available methods.
answer_4.guideline: Human raters evaluate generated sentences for style disentanglement and content preservation.
